fallBackModes.name: Ordered Retreat
fallBackModes.effect: Move up to M characteristic and end unengaged. Cannot shoot, charge, or start an action this turn.

fallBackModes.name: Desperate Escape
fallBackModes.condition: Unit is Battle-shocked (or chooses Desperate Escape to move through enemy models)
fallBackModes.effect: Make a Hazard roll for each model before moving; can move through enemy models; if not already Battle-shocked, must take a Battle-shock test after moving.

phaseSequence.label: Pre-game
subSteps: 1. Declare Battle Formations (Attach max 1 Leader + 1 Support per Bodyguard unit; declare Transports & Strategic Reserves)
2. Deploy Armies & Fortifications
3. Resolve Pre-Battle Abilities & Scouts X" Moves
4. Determine First Turn

phaseSequence.label: Start of Battle Round
subSteps: 1. Resolve Start of Battle Round Army & Detachment Rules
2. Select Round-Scoped Doctrines / Stances / Protocols

phaseSequence.label: Command Phase
subSteps: 1. Both Players Gain 1 CP (Start of Command Phase)
2. Resolve Command Phase Army, Detachment, and Unit Abilities
3. Battle-Shock Step: Roll 2D6 for each friendly unit Below Half-Strength (<50% models or wounds); if failed, OC becomes 0 and unit cannot be targeted by friendly Stratagems

phaseSequence.label: Movement Phase
subSteps: 1. Move Units: Normal Move, Advance Move, Remain Stationary, or Fall-Back Move (Ordered Retreat vs Desperate Escape)
2. Reinforcements / Ingress Step: Set up Reserves / Deep Strike units >8" horizontally from all enemy models

phaseSequence.label: Shooting Phase
subSteps: 1. Select Eligible Unit & Shooting Mode (Normal, Assault, Close-Quarters, Indirect, or Snap Shooting)
2. 11th Ed Terrain Check: Units obscured by terrain beyond 15" (Hidden/Concealed) cannot be targeted
3. Resolve Ranged Attacks & Reactive Moves

phaseSequence.label: Charge Phase
subSteps: 1. Select Eligible Unengaged Unit to Charge
2. 11th Ed Charge Sequence: Make 2D6 Charge Roll FIRST, then select reachable Charge Target(s)
3. Resolve Charge Move (must end in Engagement Range)

phaseSequence.label: Fight Phase
subSteps: 1. Fights First Step (Alternating activations starting with non-active player)
2. Remaining Combats Step (Alternating activations starting with non-active player)
3. 11th Ed Fight Sequence: Simultaneous Pile-In Move -> Make Melee Attacks -> Simultaneous Consolidation Move (or Overrun Fight)

phaseSequence.label: End of Turn
subSteps: 1. Score End-of-Turn Primary & Secondary Mission VP
2. Resolve End of Turn Abilities & Strategic Reserves Pick-Ups
3. Clear Phase/Turn-Scoped Effects

phaseSequence.label: End of Battle Round
subSteps: 1. Score End-of-Battle-Round Objectives
2. Advance to Next Battle Round (up to Round 5)
